name: managing-personal-finance-project
description: This application will help user managing their personal finance. The application solves the problem that many students and young adults face regarding their financial management. By building a complete system from user authentication to financial tracking to solve a real-world problem, I can demonstrate both my technical and business skills. Through this project, I will be using skills such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the frontend, Node.js and Express for the backend, and Sequelize for database management.
